scope: Read-only discovery index of existing installed authoring and Host-owned native shapes; no new validator or authority contract

adapter_methods.execute: execute(envelope, correlation) -> exactly {status_schema, status}; finite native action only
adapter_methods.observe: observe(sources) -> exactly the declared source keys with actual acquired_at, uncertainty, quality and origin-age facts; passive

source_revision: Use enclosing SDK manifest.source.commit and component tree; this index never uses a mutable latest contract
